units.title: Human systems, homeostasis and feedback
prerequisites: ability to interpret a simple labelled diagram
learning_outcomes: trace a basic stimulus–response loop
explain how respiratory and circulatory systems cooperate during activity
distinguish a short-term response from a longer-term adaptation
state limits of a simplified model

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: Educational anatomy only. Persistent symptoms, pain, breathing difficulty or health concerns belong with a trusted adult and qualified health professional; no self-diagnosis.

units.title: Nutrition, sleep, recovery and health-claim literacy
prerequisites: ability to compare claims with evidence
learning_outcomes: describe broad roles of carbohydrates, fats, proteins, vitamins, minerals and water
explain why energy and nutrient needs vary
distinguish sleep opportunity, sleep quality and recovery
evaluate a health claim for evidence, scope and uncertainty

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: No calorie targets, weight-loss prescriptions, supplement recommendations or diagnosis. For a young learner, nutrition and sleep changes should be discussed with a parent/guardian and qualified clinician when health concerns exist.

units.title: Acceleration, deceleration, landing and change of direction
learning_outcomes: describe acceleration and braking as distinct movement tasks
demonstrate controlled low-intensity landing mechanics
identify space, traction and fatigue constraints
design a progressive practice with recovery and stop rules

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: For a developing athlete, prioritize supervision, safe surfaces, modest volume and technique. No maximal sprint, heavy loading or plyometric testing without qualified coaching and age-appropriate preparation.

units.title: Football scanning, support angles and decision-making
learning_outcomes: scan before receiving and identify relevant information
create a useful support angle rather than hiding behind a defender
select a simple action based on pressure, space and teammate position
review decisions using evidence rather than outcome alone

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: Keep drills age-appropriate, avoid collisions and unsafe surfaces, and do not use public footage of others without permission.

units.title: Safe vocal production, breath coordination and fatigue awareness
prerequisites: ability to follow a short warm-up
basic awareness of comfortable speaking/singing range
learning_outcomes: describe breath coordination without forcing airflow
use gentle warm-up and cool-down habits
distinguish expressive effort from strain
recognise signs to stop and seek appropriate help

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: No forced high notes, extreme vocal exercises, shouting challenges or breath-holding contests. Persistent hoarseness, pain or voice loss should be discussed with a trusted adult and qualified clinician/voice professional.

units.title: Interpretation, stage presence and deliberate rehearsal
prerequisites: ability to prepare a short spoken or musical piece
learning_outcomes: identify the intention and audience of a short performance
shape phrasing, pacing and emphasis to communicate meaning
rehearse one variable at a time
use playback or feedback without treating taste as objective fact

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: Respect copyright and performance permissions. Do not pressure a learner to perform publicly or disclose personal material.

units.title: Visual hierarchy, grid systems and information layout
prerequisites: ability to identify a target audience and task
learning_outcomes: identify the primary task and information priority
use size, position, spacing and contrast to establish hierarchy
apply a simple alignment/grid system
evaluate a layout for readability at realistic viewing size

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: Use licensed or self-created assets; do not imitate a living designer’s exact signature style or use protected logos without permission.

units.title: Colour relationships, contrast and accessible visual communication
prerequisites: basic colour naming and visual comparison
learning_outcomes: distinguish hue, value and saturation
explain how foreground/background contrast affects legibility
build a restrained palette with functional roles
avoid communicating essential information through colour alone

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: Avoid using colour alone for warnings or critical information. Verify accessibility guidance against current standards when publishing production interfaces.

units.title: Observational drawing: proportion, form and value
learning_outcomes: measure relative proportions using visual comparison
construct an object from simple 2D/3D forms
identify light direction and major value groups
revise a drawing using observation rather than symbol memory

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: Use safe materials and a comfortable posture; avoid prolonged strain. Use references lawfully and credit sources when required.

units.title: Composition, visual storytelling and thumbnail iteration
learning_outcomes: define a visual focal point and supporting hierarchy
use value, shape, scale and direction to guide attention
generate multiple thumbnails before committing to detail
explain how composition changes narrative interpretation

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: Respect copyright and consent when using photographs or people as references; do not publish another person’s likeness without permission.

units.title: Kitchen independence: hygiene, preparation and simple meal workflow
prerequisites: adult supervision and access to a safe kitchen
learning_outcomes: identify clean/dirty workflow and basic contamination risks
use safe handwashing and surface practices
follow a simple preparation sequence
identify tasks requiring adult supervision or specialist equipment

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: A minor must have adult supervision for knives, hot surfaces, appliances and unfamiliar equipment. Follow local food-safety authority guidance; never guess cooking temperatures or storage times.

units.title: Navigation, appointments and personal contingency planning
prerequisites: ability to contact a trusted adult
learning_outcomes: plan a route using reliable information and time buffers
identify decision points and safe alternatives
prepare essential appointment information without oversharing
use a check-in and escalation plan when a journey changes

assessment.pass_threshold: 11/15; BODY, ATH, PERF and INDEP require 12/15 where safety-critical criteria apply

units.safety_or_ethics: For a young learner, route practice and appointments require guardian approval and supervision appropriate to local conditions. Never publish live location, home address, identity documents or private contact details.

workflow_contract.assignment: ATHENA assigns objective, prerequisites, success criteria and evidence requirements.
workflow_contract.study: Learner chooses and studies external sources; source provenance is recorded.
workflow_contract.evaluation: Evaluator checks explanation, application, transfer, uncertainty and safety.
workflow_contract.commit: A structured proposal is previewed; learner approval is required before persistent commit.
workflow_contract.mastery: No automatic mastery from reading, lesson completion, AI-generated text or a single score.
